name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: Read-only Agent Skill Marketplace that audits any public website for AI discoverability and on-site engagement, then emits one evidence-backed findings report.

skills.description: Entrypoint. Fetches a site snapshot, runs specialist skills, and emits one Adobe-schema audit report.
Reach/Read. robots.txt, HTTP status/redirects, noindex, optional HTML vs rendered DOM gap.
Extract. Parse JSON-LD. Flag invalid or incomplete Product/Offer markup on product pages. Never flag missing schema blindly.
Extract. Claims, contradictions, missing units, ungrounded superlatives.
Trust. Date signals, stale content, 2-3 public corroboration sources.
Use. Organization name, sameAs, NAP consistency across pages.
On-site. First impression, navigation, deep-page context/breadcrumbs, CTA actionability. Not llms.txt or OpenAPI.
